property_summary: For any target address and value, when the target's fallback/receive REVERTs, the reference C's sendMoney returns false from the low-level call (so the call itself fails but does NOT revert the caller) while the mutant using transfer will instead revert the entire sendMoney call; thus the reference never reverts the caller for a reverting callee, whereas the mutant sometimes does.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a simple transfer to the target ignoring _data (so behavior and forwarded data differ).
